title: Can this person vote?
description: Write a function `can_vote(age)` that returns True if `age` is 18 or older, and False otherwise.
examples:
can_vote(20) -> True
can_vote(15) -> False
can_vote(18) -> True
hints: This only needs a single comparison, no elif required.
Think about which comparison operator means 'greater than or equal to'.
explanation: A comparison expression like `age >= 18` already evaluates to True or False, so it can be returned directly without an if/else block.
